text:
marco_partnerships: quick flag for the marketplace announce: vendors surfaced three small-but-material incompatibilities. proposing a soft-launch (limited regions + partner rollouts) rather than a full global wave. thoughts? :rotating_light:
anna_amd: MI300 pilot racks delayed by customs + a driver ABI tweak. can probably do partner-only validation cluster in eu-central early July but not full GA.
olga_gaudi: Gaudi runtime has a host-NIC scheduling race that degrades multi-host scaling. patch in review; if it lands next week we could do a regional preview.
peter_nvidia: H100 variants OK overall but there's a firmware diff between OEM images that affects thermal headroom on some B200-like racks. we can provide a tested H100-B200 combo image for canary regions.
sofia_ops: Ops constraints: SKU metadata + image URIs required 72h pre-publish. If we do soft-launch we need per-region SKU flags and a limited region list right away.
ivan_si: SI impact: we need hardware in-hand to finish the final cert. With MI300/Gaudi delays, we recommend: 1) publish core SKUs globally (H100/H200/B200) but mark Gaudi/MI300 as "limited partner preview"; 2) enable actual images only in canary regions via feature flags.
maya_singh: agree. eng will prepare a fallback matrix and an automated tag scheme. proposal for SKU naming:
```
market::gpu::h100-v1
market::gpu::b200-v1
market::gpu::gaudi-preview-v1
market::gpu::mi300-partner-v1
```
This lets ops filter easily.
sam_legal: Messaging guidance: use neutral phrases like "limited partner availability" or "regional preview". avoid release dates publicly; for partner comms we can be specific but require partner asset sign-off 48h prior.
marco_partnerships: Proposed decision:
- Public: announce H100/H200/B200 globally on 2026-06-22 with clear guidance about region/thermal notes.
- Soft-launch: open Gaudi + MI300 as "partner-limited preview" in us-west1 + eu-central1 only, gated by image URIs and feature flags.
- Contingency: if patches/AWB arrive before 6/18 we can expand regions; otherwise schedule a full follow-up wave in July.
Owners: comms=marco_partnerships, ops=sofia_ops, SI=ivan_si, eng=maya_singh, vendors=anna_amd/olga_gaudi/peter_nvidia, legal=sam_legal.
release-bot: Event created: "Marketplace soft-launch announce (limited regions)"  2026-06-22  https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/marketplace-soft-launch-2026-06-22
ivan_si: I'll open the cert repo PR for a "preview" lane and add relaxed perf gates + telemetry checklist.
sofia_ops: I'll draft region list and SKU flags, and prepare separate release notes stubs (public + partner-only).
maya_singh: Eng action: produce fallback matrix and feature-flag hooks; CI will skip gaudi/mi300 jobs until hardware appears. I'll drop the repo stub in #eng later today.
anna_amd: I'll try to accelerate one MI300 validation batch; will post any updates here.
olga_gaudi: We'll prioritize the NIC scheduling patch and post a build SHA once tests pass.
marco_partnerships: thanks all. plan sounds good. keep this thread for ETA updates only; will re-open if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
